svg.title: JDBC Redisson Synchronous Repository Hierarchy
svg.desc: UML-style sync Redisson hierarchy rebuilt from exposed-jdbc-redisson repository and map adapter source files.
svg.text: The sync repository implements the JDBC Redis contract while Redisson MapLoader and MapWriter adapters bridge cache misses and writes into Exposed JDBC DSL.

g.text: User repositories extend the abstract base
Concrete repositories provide table, ResultRow.toEntity(), updateEntity(), insertEntity(), and extractId() for their DTO.
This class diagram shows the synchronous Redisson contract only; suspend repository wiring is covered by the architecture and sequence views.
Implement updateEntity and insertEntity only when write-through or write-behind should call the Exposed MapWriter.
